decision: 5 second time penalty (1 penalty points imposed, total of 10 points in the 12-month period).
event_name: Document 47 Date 27 September 2020 Time 14:53 2020 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 September 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of the FIA International Sporting Code Article 12.1.1 (i), failure to follow the instructions contained in the Event Notes (v3) item 19.1, practice start location at 13:35 and Article 36.1 FIA Formula 1 Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. The driver performed the practice start near the end, but directly in the pit exit. Art 36.1 requires drivers to use constant throttle and constant speed in the pit exit other than in the place designated for practice starts in the Event Notes item 19.1., which is defined as the place "on the right hand side" after the pit exit lights (and is not part of the track as defined by lines) which has been known to all competitors and used without exception.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 44 2Nd Practice Start
